response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.avg_bw, g.n, m.mean_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_kept_averages, SUM(n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(avg_bw - mean_avg) AS avg_excess FROM k
